STEP 3 - Items: Greek salad (tomato, cucumber, feta, olives), chicken wrap (two halves), carrot cake slice with cream cheese frosting, tea (cup, plain).

STEP 4 - Area: Salad covers about 50% of its bowl (about 88 cm²). The wrap covers about 25% of its plate (about 80 cm²). The cake covers about 20% of its plate (about 60 cm²).

STEP 6 - Grams: Salad 177 ml × 0.6 ≈ 100 g. Wrap 250 ml × 0.7 ≈ 180 g. Cake 120 ml × 0.75 ≈ 90 g. Tea 180 g.

STEP 7 - Energy: Salad 100 g × 80 kcal/100 g ≈ 80 kcal. Wrap 180 g × 190 kcal/100 g ≈ 342 kcal. Cake 90 g × 380 kcal/100 g ≈ 342 kcal. Tea 180 g × 1 kcal/100 g ≈ 2 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total is about 550 g and about 770 kcal. That is plausible for a full lunch of this type with a sweet slice and a wrap.
